newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangzhou Inv sells stake in China firm.
newsitem.headline: Guangzhou Inv sells stake in China firm.

text.p: Guangzhou Investment Co Ltd said on Sunday it will sell a 25 percent stake in China Century Cement Ltd to joint venture partner CBR Cimenteries SA of Belgium.
China Century Cement holds equity in three cement firms in southern China's Guangdong.
It said Guangzhou Investment also bought a three percent interest in China Century Cement from its Chinese shareholder Guangzhou Cement Co Ltd for US$3.3 million.

After the two transactions, Guangzhou investment's stake in the joint venture will be cut to 70 percent from 92 percent, Guangzhou Cement's to zero from three percent, and CBR's raised to 30 percent from five percent.
The deals give China Century Cement greater access to CBR's technical and managerial expertise which will gradually help bring its business to international standards, the statement said.
CBR will also be heading the overseas marketing and technical support units of China Century Cement's centralised management team, it added.

China Century Cement would raise its interest in subsidiary Zhujiang Cement to 71 percent from 51 percent for US$34 million, the statement said. Zhujiang Cement has an annual production capacity of 1.2 million tonnes.
CBR was not immediately available to comment.
